core:fertility_adult_rate.note: The chance of a conception attempt when the factors of woman and man from 5.6 are both 1; the scenario's adult rate, not the biological maximum.

core:fertility_pause.note: Months after a birth before her attempts begin again (t >= birth + pause * MONTH).

core:fertility_wish_tilt.source: tools/life_reference.py: closed towns of 1000 founders over 300 years (burn-in 100), local regression over 37 runs of 12 towns, checked on 48 new towns
core:fertility_wish_tilt.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 11.3, alpha, log weight per wished child (P_n ~ p_n e^(alpha n)), fitted to 2.20 live births per woman reaching 50; approximate standard error 0.0031

core:learning_plateau.note: kappa of the learning function: one standard deviation of talent raises the plateau by e^kappa (play value).

core:learning_speed.note: nu of the learning function: one standard deviation of talent shortens the time constant by e^(-nu) (play value).

core:learning_time.note: tau_0, the time constant of learning in hours at talent 0 (play value).

core:market_age.note: Single persons take part in the partner market from their 16th birthday (Dario: partnerships from 16, never below).

core:market_candidates.note: At most k single men of market age per searching woman, by rank, relatives with phi >= 1/8 skipped.

core:market_search_center_female.source: tools/life_reference.py: closed towns of 1000 founders over 300 years (burn-in 100), local regression over 37 runs of 12 towns, checked on 48 new towns
core:market_search_center_female.note: 11.2 with Grok R8, m of the search rate s_f(a) of women; approximate standard error 0.025

core:market_search_factor_minor.source: tools/life_reference.py: closed towns of 1000 founders over 300 years (burn-in 100), local regression over 37 runs of 12 towns, checked on 48 new towns
core:market_search_factor_minor.note: Grok R6b and R8, rho, factor on s_f(a) from the 16th until before the 18th birthday; approximate standard error 0.0015

core:market_search_height_female.source: tools/life_reference.py: closed towns of 1000 founders over 300 years (burn-in 100), local regression over 37 runs of 12 towns, checked on 48 new towns
core:market_search_height_female.note: 11.2 with Grok R8, c of the search rate s_f(a) of women, per market round; approximate standard error 2e-05

core:market_search_width.note: The width of the search rate s_f(a) = min(1, c e^(-1/2 ((a - m) / 7)^2)), set, not fitted.

core:pairing_age_gap_preferred.source: tools/life_reference.py: closed towns of 1000 founders over 300 years (burn-in 100), local regression over 37 runs of 12 towns, checked on 48 new towns
core:pairing_age_gap_preferred.note: 11.2 with Grok R8, mu_a of the age term (man older), with w_a 0.02, fitted to a mean age gap of 3.0; approximate standard error 0.016

core:pairing_cousin_odds.note: The kinship term 16 ln(10) phi: a stranger is chosen ten times as often as an otherwise equal first cousin (phi = 1/16).

core:pairing_kinship_limit.note: Candidates with kinship phi >= 1/8 are skipped (2.7).

core:pairing_weight_age.note: w_a, utility per squared year of the age gap minus mu_a (a normal kernel with spread 5 years).

core:pairing_weight_cognition.source: tools/life_reference.py: closed towns of 1000 founders over 300 years (burn-in 100), local regression over 37 runs of 12 towns, checked on 48 new towns
core:pairing_weight_cognition.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 11.2, w_K, utility per squared phenotype difference; approximate standard error 0.0019

core:pairing_weight_height.source: tools/life_reference.py: closed towns of 1000 founders over 300 years (burn-in 100), local regression over 37 runs of 12 towns, checked on 48 new towns
core:pairing_weight_height.note: docs/genetik-spezifikation.md 11.2, w_H, utility per squared phenotype difference; approximate standard error 0.0013

core:pregnancy_length.note: Months from conception to birth, 280 days (real about 266, rounded up).

core:separation_rate.source: tools/life_reference.py: closed towns of 1000 founders over 300 years (burn-in 100), local regression over 37 runs of 12 towns, checked on 48 new towns
core:separation_rate.note: ADR-0018 section 3, lambda_sep, fitted so that a third of all partnerships end by separation; approximate standard error 1.8e-05

fertility_wish_shape.note: p_0, weight of the wish for no child.
p_1, weight of the wish for one child.
p_2, weight of the wish for two children.
p_3, weight of the wish for three children.
p_4, weight of the wish for four children; the shape has mean 2.10 [W11.3a].
